title: Z index for animations in battle

posts.author: cozathemaster
posts.body:
Hello! I would like to know if there is an option in RPG Maker MZ to display an animation in battle, but on a layer behind the enemy (Z index). I would like to place some animations that go behind both characters and enemies.
I'm using side-view battles, in case that matters (I mention it because I read some old posts, from 2020, but they were for RPG Maker MV, where they suggested a solution for the issue I mentioned, but only for front-view battles.).
Maybe a plugin or script?
Any ideas? Thanks in advance!

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
cozathemaster said:
Unfortunately, it’s not compatible with VisuStella's Battle Core
Click to expand...
Ah, see, this is why it's important to mention which plugins you're using. No worries, though, I'm sure someone will find a use for it.
So, the error in your screenshot is being thrown by
addChild
, via this line:
JavaScript:
this[C2].addChild(fakeContainer[SYM]())
It expects some object to have a
parent
property, but that object happens to be
null
when checked, therefore has no properties. It's related in some way to
this[C2]
, the new "below battlers" animation container sprite, but it isn't that container specifically because otherwise the error would be "cannot read property
addChild
[of blah]".
From what you said, I'm guessing VisuStella run some mystery extra code that messes up my approach in some way. There are a lot of ways to achieve that, though, and if you've updated your PIXI version (which I suspect you have, based on those pixi.js line/col numbers) then that may also affect things. Yes, even if it works OK with Battle Core turned off. Like
@TheAM-Dol
said, it'd be a lot of effort to figure out the root cause on this end, largely due to VisuStella's obfuscation.
Battle Core mentions
Spriteset_Battle
changes, so the incompatibility doesn't surprise me:
Battle Core VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
Spriteset_Battle Update​
The spriteset now has extra containers to separate battlers (actors and enemies), animations, and damage.
Click to expand...
If you're lucky, VisuStella might already have their own implementation for this animation-layering thing. I think they have a Discord server or such for support, so you might try asking there~
